signIn.title: Platform sign in
signIn.subtitle: For $t(common:platform.name) operators only. Business staff sign in to their own admin.

forbidden: Your role cannot open this page.

shared.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit logs of the platform and of the business (at least 5 characters).

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.description: Every business on $t(common:platform.name): find one, open it, or provision a new one.
tenants.name: Business

provision.title: Provision a tenant
provision.description: Creates the business, its first location, its owner's account and its web address.
provision.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; the website answers on <name>.{{domain}}.
provision.locationCodeHint: 2–10 capital letters or digits, printed on receipts.
provision.modulesHint: Prefilled from the business type. Unticked modules are not available to the business.
provision.doneDescription: {{name}} is ready. Give the owner this temporary password through a safe channel.
provision.passwordWarning: It is shown only now and never stored. Ask the owner to sign in with it soon; once in, the owner can reset the passwords of the business's staff.

tenant.suspendedBanner: This business is suspended: its staff, location hubs and website are refused until it is reactivated.
tenant.archivedBanner: This business is archived: it can be read but not changed.
tenant.statusDescription: Suspending refuses the business's staff, hubs and website at once; its hubs keep their unsent changes until it is reactivated.

modules.description: What the platform allows this business. A business can only switch the modules marked as switchable.

branding.description: What the business set for its screens (read only).

domains.description: The web addresses of the business's website. Verifying looks the DNS record up again.

payments.description: Provider accounts of the business. Secrets are never shown: only whether one is stored and its fingerprint.

health.title: Health board
health.description: Every business at a glance: hubs and terminals, synchronization and server errors. Refreshes every 30 seconds.

releases.title: Releases
releases.description: The version the cloud runs, the releases $t(common:platform.name) published, and the version every device reports. A release’s minimums decide which hubs and apps the cloud still serves.
releases.publishDescription: The minimums apply once the cloud runs this version: older hubs and apps are refused until they are updated. The platform admin itself is never refused.
releases.minHint: Leave empty for no minimum. It cannot be above the release’s version.
releases.nothingOutdated: Every device is up to date
releases.rolloutDescription: Which releases this business follows. Its devices are flagged when they run an older version; the cloud’s minimums apply whatever the channel.
releases.pinHint: A pinned business stays on this version whatever its channel publishes.

audit.title: Platform audit log
audit.description: What platform operators did: sign-ins, provisioning, status changes, configuration and repairs, with their reasons.
audit.actionHint: Exact action or a prefix ending in a dot, e.g. support.

support.title: Support tools
support.description: Find records of a business and repair them safely: every repair is previewed, confirmed with a reason and audited. There is no free-form editing.
support.findPlaceholder: Id, order number, phone, name, SKU or barcode

operations.sync_retry: Ask the hub to resend a refused change
operations.sync_reprocess: Apply a refused change from the hub

support.confirmDescription: The change is applied to {{name}} and written to both audit logs with your reason.
support.noRepairs: Your role can find records but not repair them.
